final: WITH client_by_district AS (SELECT client.district_id, COUNT(*) as district_count FROM client GROUP BY client.district_id), with_district_info AS (SELECT cbd.district_id, d.A3 as region, cbd.district_count FROM client_by_district cbd JOIN district d ON cbd.district_id = d.district_id), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(district_count) as region_total FROM with_district_info GROUP BY region), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(district_count) as overall_total FROM client_by_district) SELECT wdi.district_id, wdi.region, wdi.district_count, CAST(wdi.district_count AS FLOAT) / rt.region_total as share_of_region, CAST(wdi.district_count AS FLOAT) / ot.overall_total as share_of_overall FROM with_district_info wdi JOIN region_totals rt ON wdi.region = rt.region CROSS JOIN overall_total ot ORDER BY share_of_overall DESC LIMIT 10
